elements.element: The liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: The added language caps “each party's aggregate liability under this Agreement.”

elements.element: The fee component of the cap includes fees both paid and payable.
elements.evidence: The cap expressly refers to “fees paid or payable.”

elements.element: The fee component is measured over the 12 months preceding the claim.
elements.evidence: The added language specifies “in the 12 months preceding the claim.”

elements.element: The alternative monetary benchmark is USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: Clause (b) expressly states “USD 1,000,000.”

elements.element: The cap is the greater of the 12-month fee component and USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The cap is expressly stated as “the greater of (a) ... and (b) USD 1,000,000.”

elements.element: Indirect damages are excluded mutually.
elements.evidence: The retained clause states that “NEITHER PARTY WILL BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER PARTY FOR ANY INDIRECT” damages.

elements.element: Consequential damages are excluded mutually.
elements.evidence: The retained clause states that “NEITHER PARTY WILL BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER PARTY FOR ANY ... CONSEQUENTIAL” damages.

elements.element: Liability for breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: “Excluded Claims,” which are excepted from the cap, include “a party's breach of its confidentiality” obligations.

elements.element: Liability for breach of data protection obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: “Excluded Claims” include breach of “data protection” obligations and are expressly excepted from the cap.

elements.element: Liability for breach of security obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: “Excluded Claims” include breach of “security obligations” and are expressly excepted from the cap.

elements.element: Liability for indemnification obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: “Excluded Claims” include “indemnification obligations” and are expressly excepted from the cap.

elements.element: Liability arising from gross negligence is uncapped.
elements.evidence: “Excluded Claims” include a party's “gross negligence” and are expressly excepted from the cap.

elements.element: Liability arising from wilful misconduct is uncapped.
elements.evidence: “Excluded Claims” include a party's “wilful misconduct” and are expressly excepted from the cap.

elements.element: Liability arising from fraud is uncapped.
elements.evidence: “Excluded Claims” include a party's “fraud” and are expressly excepted from the cap.

elements.element: Liability for infringement of the other party's intellectual property rights is uncapped.
elements.evidence: “Excluded Claims” include “infringement of the other party's intellectual property rights” and are expressly excepted from the cap.

elements.element: Customer's payment obligations are not treated as damages for purposes of the cap.
elements.evidence: The added language states: “Customer's payment obligations, being all amounts due from PB under this Agreement, are not damages for purposes of this cap.”

elements.element: The liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: The added cap applies to “each party's aggregate liability.”

elements.element: The cap amount is 12 months' fees, without an additional higher monetary floor.
elements.evidence: The rendered cap is the greater of 12 months' paid or payable fees and USD 1,000,000; it therefore is not necessarily limited to 12 months' fees.

elements.element: Liability for indemnification obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Indemnification obligations are included in “Excluded Claims,” which are excepted from the cap.

elements.element: Liability for breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Breach of confidentiality obligations is included in “Excluded Claims,” which are excepted from the cap.

elements.element: Liability arising from gross negligence is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Gross negligence is included in “Excluded Claims,” which are excepted from the cap.

elements.element: Liability arising from wilful misconduct is uncapped.
elements.evidence: Wilful misconduct is included in “Excluded Claims,” which are excepted from the cap.

result.reason: The operative language fully implements the preferred mutual cap formula, preserves the existing mutual indirect/consequential-damages exclusion, provides every required uncapped carve-out, and excludes PB's payment obligations from damages for cap purposes. Assessed independently, the fallback is not completely satisfied because its fee-only cap is replaced by a greater-of formula containing a USD 1,000,000 floor. The redline is targeted and does not disturb unrelated commercial terms, although tying a claim-specific lookback to an aggregate agreement-wide cap could create some interpretive ambiguity for multiple claims.
